```xml
<screen id="settings" label="Settings" weft="0.1">
  <heading id="title" level="1">Settings</heading>
  <section id="notifications" label="Notifications">
    <heading id="notifications-title" level="2">Notifications</heading>
    <switch id="email-alerts" checked="{$.emailAlerts}" label="Email alerts"/>
    <switch id="push-alerts" checked="{$.pushAlerts}" label="Push notifications"/>
  </section>
  <section id="appearance" label="Appearance">
    <heading id="appearance-title" level="2">Appearance</heading>
    <select id="language" label="Language" value="{$.language}">
      <option id="lang-en" value="en">English</option>
      <option id="lang-de" value="de">Deutsch</option>
      <option id="lang-fr" value="fr">Français</option>
    </select>
    <switch id="dark-mode" checked="{$.darkMode}" label="Dark mode"/>
    <switch id="auto-save" checked="{$.autoSave}" label="Auto-save"/>
  </section>
  <button id="save" disabled="{!$.dirty}" variant="primary" on-press="settings.save">Save changes</button>
</screen>
```
